title.en: Partner commission on a booked appointment

intro.sr: Partner ima dve odvojene stope provizije - jednu za usluge, drugu za proizvode. Kad klijent zakaže termin preko partnerovog koda za preporuku, provizija se obračunava po stopi za usluge, nikad po stopi za proizvode, čak i kad su podešene na potpuno različite vrednosti.
intro.en: A partner has two separate commission rates - one for services, one for products. When a customer books an appointment through a partner's referral code, commission is calculated using the services rate, never the products rate, even when they're set to very different values.

prijava.sr: Klijent se prijavljuje na svoj nalog.
prijava.en: The customer logs into their account.

otvaranje-stranice-usluge.sr: Klijent otvara stranicu usluge i bira varijantu.
otvaranje-stranice-usluge.en: The customer opens the service page and selects a variant.

izbor-datuma-i-termina.sr: Klijent bira datum i slobodan termin.
izbor-datuma-i-termina.en: The customer picks a date and an available slot.

heading.en: Enter details and the partner's coupon

unos-podataka-i-kupona.sr: Klijent unosi telefon i primenjuje partnerov kod za preporuku.
unos-podataka-i-kupona.en: The customer enters their phone number and applies the partner's referral code.

admin-prijava.sr: Administrator se prijavljuje da bi obradio termin.
admin-prijava.en: The admin logs in to process the appointment.

admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.sr: Administrator klikne na dropdown sa svojim imenom.
admin-ulazak-otvara-nalog-meni.en: The admin clicks the dropdown showing their name.

admin-termini-bira-stavku.en: The admin picks "Appointments" from the menu.

admin-termini-pretraga.sr: Administrator pretražuje po email adresi klijenta.
admin-termini-pretraga.en: The admin searches by the customer's email.

admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.sr: Administrator otvara termin zakazan preko partnera.
admin-termini-otvaranje-rezultata.en: The admin opens the appointment booked through the partner.

admin-zavrsava-termin.sr: Administrator potvrđuje pa završava termin - ovo obračunava proviziju i zaposlenog i partnera, partnerovu po stopi za usluge.
admin-zavrsava-termin.en: The admin confirms then completes the appointment - this calculates both the employee's and the partner's commission, the partner's using the services rate.
